reviews.comment: He is honestly one of the best teacher's I have ever had he makes his lectures incredibly interesting and engaging. When lecture he makes sure the class understands the material before moving forward along with keeping everyone engaged. I would highly recommend everyone to take him the test are incredibly easy as long as you review the homework's.

Easily one of the most laid-back and fun classes I've had as an engineer here. Incredibly caring, and TAs even more so. Tests and homework can be a bit tricky, but if you even remotely pay attention and keep up with the material, there is no reason you should not get an A.
Absolutely amazing professor, honestly a really funny guy, and is always willing to talk and help you out with whatever.
This is a great course, although it is not an easy A due to the physics majors taking this course. The prof was pretty chill. Would def take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Papovich has such an amazing passion for his subject matter. He is entertaining to listen to in lecture, and so much fun to be around. He grades fairly and offers a lot of chances to succeed in his class.

Genuinely my favorite professor or teacher I've ever had. His enthusiasm for the content makes lectures so fun, his passion honestly inspires. He's a very caring teacher, curves fairly, and he will tell you in class what the test questions will be over. Tests have questions from HW. Overall a joy of a class. Take him if you can.

Papovich is phenomenal. I think a lot of professors with high ratings like him have said ratings because students find the class easy. Some may find this class easy. Some may find it hard. But that won't be because of the professor. I can never concentrate in other classes, but I was always at the edge of my seat in this one. He deserves an award.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Papovich was a great prof! His homework can seem tough at first, but he gives really helpful hints after the first submission (unlimited submissions) and he will help out a lot if you email him about a question. Tests are similar to homework problems, so if you really know the homework, you'll do great on tests. Formula sheets are not great

Top tier professor - the level of mutual respect that professor papovich gives his students is unmatched. He is clearly in love with what he teaches and wants to share it with the world. Also a total stand up comedian. Take his class if you can - I promise you will come out a better student. He does make you work hard tho!

Dr. Papovich is my favorite professor I have taken at TAMU. His class is an easy B if you show up to lectures and do the homeworks. A very possible A if you put in the effort. His hws (unlimited submissions) prepare you for the midterms and he gives you hints on the exam problems in class. He also curved both of our midterms. Take him if possible.

Dr. Papovich is a genuinely a great guy! He did his best to make the transition to online painless. The homework was hard but manageable, and he was flexible with deadlines if you emailed him . The exams were tricky and I always ran out of time. I think the TAs were nitpicky with grades, but that wasn't exactly his fault and the exams were curved.
